card.name: Who/patients starting a qualifying clause
card.fires_on: The word "who", "is", or "patients"/"participants" right after a prescriber or population phrase, where a qualifying description of the group comes next (experienced, knowledgeable, with ancestry, currently on).

modes.label: Prescriber qualification
modes.description: "who" or "is" after "healthcare provider/professionals", leading into experience or knowledge requirements.
modes.example: XTAMPZA ER should be prescribed only by healthcare professionals<< who>> are knowledgeable about the use of extended-release

modes.label: Patient group after "in/for"
modes.description: "patients" or "participants" after "in" or "for", introducing a subgroup defined by a condition or treatment.
modes.example: In<< patients>> currently on basal insulin or a GLP

card.plain: It marks the spot where the label is about to say which kind of prescriber or patient group a statement applies to.
